issue.title: Bug: syslog errors "parseDatabaseConfig: Sonic database config file doesn't exist at /var/run/redis/sonic-db/database_config.json"

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

While running SONiC management test cases, syslog errors are observed indicating that the SONiC database configuration file is missing:

   parseDatabaseConfig: Sonic database config file doesn't exist at /var/run/redis/sonic-db/database_config.json

This issue is consistently seen when executing the VRF warm reboot test case. Ideally, such syslog errors should not appear during normal test execution.

###Test Case

vrf/test_vrf.py::TestVrfWarmReboot::test_vrf_system_warm_reboot

### Steps to Reproduce

Deploy SONiC image on DUT.
Ensure the testbed is up and accessible.
Execute the following SONiC management test: vrf/test_vrf.py::TestVrfWarmReboot::test_vrf_system_warm_reboot

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior
Actual Behavior

Syslog reports the following error during reboot/test execution:
parseDatabaseConfig: Sonic database config file doesn't exist at /var/run/redis/sonic-db/database_config.json

Expected Behavior

No syslog errors related to missing database_config.json should be observed.
The database configuration file should be present or correctly initialized before being accessed.

### Relevant log output

```shell
2026 Jun 17 <IPV6>.132925 str-marvell-tl10-01 ERR python: :- parseDatabaseConfig: Sonic database config file doesn't exist at /var/run/redis/sonic-db/database_config.json
```


resolution.title: Remove unused hwsku read from pddf_util
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/27988

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it
get_platform_and_hwsku() -> get_hwsku() → get_localhost_info('hwsku') with no config_db, which unconditionally opens a connection:

```
device_info.py:

def get_localhost_info(field, config_db=None):
    try:
        # TODO: enforce caller to provide config_db explicitly and remove its default value
        if not config_db:
            config_db = ConfigDBConnector()
            config_db.connect()
```

Connect() is what triggers SonicDBConfig::initialize() → parseDatabaseConfig → the ERR line, because /var/run/redis/sonic-db/database_config.json doesn't exist that early in boot.

Also we see that 'hwsku' is not used in get_path_to_device().

#### How to verify it

Verified by checking the reboot logs on x86_64-marvell_d64p512t-r0 platform and by running the 'vrf/test_vrf.py::TestVrfWarmReboot::test_vrf_system_warm_reboot' sonic-mgmt tests.
